entries.0287d64addd72959: As challenges to address, the company presents reinforcement measures for each of its five business portfolios. In sales (SS Business), it promotes technology-based proposal sales and SCM utilizing AI; in product and technology development (TS Business), it aims to strengthen development capabilities in “high vacuum/control technology” centered on four development bases and to acquire innovative technologies through business alliances and M&A; in contract assembly (MS Business), it aims to build production capacity and automate with robots and AI; in maintenance support (FS Business), it aims to expand engineers and sell AI predictive maintenance technology externally; and in precision processing (PS Business), it aims to enhance precision processing capabilities through business alliances and M&A.

entries.4b6545d52c25c4ca: The group has both sales and contract manufacturing functions, and its distinctive feature is a system that provides integrated services from sales through design and development, assembly, processing and maintenance, through five business portfolios: sales (SS Business), product and technology development (TS Business), contract assembly (MS Business), precision processing (PS Business) and maintenance support (FS Business). entries.ce498317d1b258e9: The company formulated a new Medium-Term Management Plan, “MIRAI 2030,” starting in fiscal 2026. Under its purpose of “Creating New Value,” while carrying forward the basic strategies of the previous plan, “MIRAI 2026,” the company has newly added three growth strategies: a physical AI strategy (automated assembly of manufacturing equipment and realization of AI predictive maintenance through AI and robotics), an AI/SCM system strategy (evolution into a “procurement hub” using AI agents), and an AI talent development strategy (AI-utilized talent development and inheritance of engineers’ and skilled workers’ knowledge). It aims to expand its business through business model transformation centered on AI business, and to transform from “contract manufacturing” into a “manufacturer” providing total solutions.
